name: DocTract
summary: DocTract (doctract.com) is a policy-management SaaS for publishing and governing an organization's Policies and Procedures. Its DocTract MCP Server add-on gives an MCP-compatible assistant (such as Microsoft Copilot) a live, read-only, permission-aware connection to the customer's current published Policies: an employee's policy question is answered from the relevant excerpts, each cited by document name, number and a link, and the assistant is told to say when no Policy matches. An administrator connects it through the org's IdP; the assistant searches as the signed-in employee.

agentAccess.notes: An add-on for DocTract customers; an admin connects it to the org IdP (page names Microsoft Entra ID as an example) and each employee signs in with their org identity, scoping search per person. auth 'other': an IdP sign-in is documented, no OAuth/OIDC/SAML protocol or grant named. Read-only.

payments.notes: Add-on via sales contact ('Schedule a demo'); no public dollar price (/pricing, /plans 404), priceList null, no agent-settled path. Terms of Use (doctract.com/legal, Qualex Corporation) publish routes: a Payment Processor bills a linked Billing Account (card-on-file); invoice by email if agreed.

jobs.summary: The vendor states its MCP Server lets an assistant search the customer's current published DocTract Policies for the employee and answer from the relevant excerpts, each cited by name, number and link, and is told to say when no Policy matches. No measured accuracy/citation figure is published.
